description: Build, run and analyze aerosol simulations; investigate and report concerns; develop, test, document and review Particula.

defaultPrompt: Help me install Particula and check my local Python environment.
Build and run a small condensation simulation, then plot and explain the results.
Debug my Particula script and check its units, conservation, and time-step sensitivity.
interface.longDescription: Seven researcher workflows for setup, guidance, simulation design, execution, analysis, debugging and issue reporting, plus five Particula repository skills for planning, development, testing, documentation and review. Uses the selected checkout and environment. Reports require researcher review before posting. No hosted service, automatic Python installation or MCP server is included.

publication.release_notes: Adds researcher issue reporting with version-matched investigation, a scientific issue format and approval before posting. Validated plugin version bumps now publish GitHub releases automatically, independently of Python library releases.

name: particula-helper
